title: @actor.group
description: a group under @actor.group: the charter, every key but children, and its members; merged over the backend's baseline, lib/actor/<backend>.json

backend.description: the supervisor that enforces the charter

strategy.description: which members restart when one exits: only that one

restart.description: whether a member's exit restarts it, for every member that sets none

intensity.description: restarts allowed before the group gives up

period.description: milliseconds intensity counts over, under effection only; s7 counts over the whole run and refuses it

pool.description: an open pool whose tokens leaf members take to start

mailbox.description: how members message each other: none opens no pool, pool an inbox per member

kind.description: the kind of every member that sets none; without it, goal for children and call for a member joined by its at line

ask.description: under mailbox pool, whether a member that sets no ask gets a reply pool

kinds.description: the kinds the backend hosts, each with the defaults a member of that kind starts from; from the baseline, and a kind it lacks is refused

children.description: the members by id; a member of kind goal is the target of its id, of kind group the group of its id
